title: Split-body machine
statement: Given a finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet and a start state of $M$, define a finite Turing machine with one more work tape and control states for the anchor, preparation, counting, checking, rewinding, restoring, and emitting stages. Its initial state is the anchor; its transitions implement these stages, using $M$ during counting and the corresponding preparation, rewind, restore, and emit procedures in their stages.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet
caveat: The transition rules invoke helper machines and actions whose definitions are not included, so their behavior cannot be rendered more specifically from this payload.
